summary: Iteration 6 (QR Protection Presets + Country Analytics on Overview) — Backend pytest 10/10 pass (100%): POST /api/qr with protection_preset=strict/moderate/off stores correct protection block (strict -> enabled=true, block_bots/tor/datacenter/proxy_vpn=true, block_action=block_page; moderate -> block_datacenter=false, block_action=fallback; off/omitted -> enabled=false, preset=off); unknown preset -> HTTP 400; QR protection is readable/patchable via shared /api/links/{qr_id}/protection endpoints (QR docs live in links collection); PATCH {preset:'moderate'} on a QR updates the stored preset. QR redirect enforcement (/api/r/{alias}): strict QR blocks python-requests and curl UAs (no 302 to destination), and allows a Chrome UA to 302 when coming from a residential IP (114.4.5.6). Country analytics: /api/analytics/overview.top_countries is a list<=8 of {name,count}; end-to-end test hitting /api/r/{alias} with X-Forwarded-For 114.4.5.6 & 8.8.8.8 records events that surface as ID & US ISO codes. Regression: QR list/pause/resume/destination-update (versioned)/delete all OK. JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/it6_results.xml. Frontend e2e via admin login on preview URL: Overview '/app' renders 'Traffic by country' card (data-testid=overview-countries-card) with 5 rows for the admin workspace — country-row-ID 🇮🇩 'Indonesia' 3 33%, country-row-US 🇺🇸 'United States' 2 22%, country-row-Unknown 🌐 'Unknown (geo pending)' 2 22%, country-row-AU 🇦🇺 'Australia' 1 11%, country-row-NO 🇳🇴 'Norway' 1 11%. Full country names resolve via Intl.DisplayNames. QRPage 'New Dynamic QR' dialog shows qr-preset-select with off/moderate/strict options; creating TEST_it6_ui with preset=strict shows the 'Dynamic QR created' toast, appears in the list, and /api/links/{id}/protection returns preset=strict, enabled=true, block_datacenter=true, block_action=block_page. Editing the same QR opens the dialog with qr-name-input visible and qr-preset-select HIDDEN (create-only, as intended). Stats button routes to /app/links/{id} where the LinkDetail Protection card + protection-presets row render correctly. All acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: qr.create_qr mirrors links.create_link preset logic exactly (DEFAULT_PROTECTION + PROTECTION_PRESETS + 400 on unknown). Consistent, good.

QR docs are stored in the shared links collection with is_qr=True and reuse the same /api/links/{id}/protection endpoints (which do not filter by is_qr). This is a deliberate design choice that keeps protection logic single-sourced but relies on callers knowing QR IDs are valid link IDs. Documented via the review request — acceptable.
analytics.overview.top_countries limit correctly raised from 5 -> 8 to match the UI card capacity.

Overview.jsx CountryCard uses Intl.DisplayNames('en',{type:'region'}) for full country names and a code-point flag helper — no external deps. Empty state ('No traffic yet') is rendered; 'Unknown (geo pending)' fallback for null geo is clear.
QRPage.jsx wraps the preset Select in {!editing && ...} so it is create-only, matching the spec. Default value is 'off'. Good.

Minor: QR update endpoint (PATCH /api/qr/{id}) intentionally does NOT accept protection_preset; users must go to the LinkDetail page to change protection. This is consistent with iter5's ProtectionSettings component but worth calling out for docs.

Minor: /api/r/{alias} treats an incoming 'python-requests' / 'curl' UA as a bot regardless of preset, and strict correctly blocks. Datacenter/proxy-VPN blocking is heuristic (IP-based) — the test container's egress IP is flagged as datacenter, so any test hitting /api/r/{alias} without X-Forwarded-For and using strict will 403 the Chrome UA too. Not a bug, just a testing gotcha (documented in test_iter6_qr_presets_geo.py).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the specified UI checks (overview-countries-card + 5 country rows w/ flags & names & %; qr-preset-select on create; preset hidden on edit; create-with-strict toast + list + persisted protection via API; Stats -> LinkDetail Protection card)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-6 backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_qr_presets_geo.py (10 tests, 100% pass; JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/it6_results.xml). Key facts: QR docs live in the 'links' collection with is_qr=True; protection GET/PATCH is served by the /api/links/{id}/protection endpoints (no is_qr filter in _get_owned). Preset logic is identical to Smart Links: off is a no-op that leaves DEFAULT_PROTECTION unchanged, unknown -> 400. Overview.top_countries limit is 8, breakdown items are {name, count} with name = ISO-2 code or 'Unknown'. Frontend testids: qr-preset-select + qr-preset-{off|moderate|strict} in create dialog (hidden on edit); overview-countries-card + country-row-{CODE} on '/app'.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All acceptance criteria for QR Protection Presets and Country Analytics on the Overview pass end-to-end.
